name: Bouc-Wen state residual
reason: The raw files expose one ordered forward-to-backward transition per condition but do not expose repeated loops, minor loops, or a verified state-reset convention.

name: rolling-friction hysteresis residual
reason: Measured torque and motion are available, but internal rolling-friction state cannot be identified from one direction pair without repeated reversal cycles and reset evidence.

name: rate-independent play or stop operator
reason: A play or stop operator requires repeated major and minor loops to identify memory and saturation; those excitation patterns are absent.

name: temperature- and load-conditioned hysteresis
reason: Temperature and load vary across conditions, but there are no repeated loops at matched conditions and no acquisition-level reset or warm-up labels for separating state from condition effects.

name: white-box hysteresis state plus learned residual
reason: The white-box state can be exercised with a synthetic oracle, while a learned real-data residual would otherwise absorb unknown initial state and unvalidated transition samples.

name: matched-history NARX or GRU comparator
reason: Raw row order supports an offline reconstructed reversal trajectory, but the current Wave 4.4 windows do not provide repeated physical loops or a deterministic reset contract required for a promotable comparator.
